verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs claim continuous monitoring with alerts, which is the core of the story. Nothing documents where those alerts are delivered or what they contain. The ClickUp and Jira ticketing integrations are documented as Change Management connections, not as a channel for sending control-failure alerts. The webhooks receive inbound data only, and the status-page email covers Sprinto's own incidents, so neither counts. Missing for 10: documented Slack delivery of control-failure or drift alerts, documented email alerts for failing controls, automatic ticket creation for findings, alert content with remediation context, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding

citations.quote: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
integrating with your existing cloud stack, continuously monitoring your systems
